content: The Marvel Cinematic Universe's next major event begins in December with the release of Avengers: Doomsday, which will be followed by Secret Wars next year. While trailers have only hinted at what these massive films will have in store for the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, and more, we know they are heavily inspired by the 2015 Secret Wars event comic. Now Marvel is returning to that era with a new limited series in the lead-up to Doomsday.
